summary: Scales a collision penalty value: dereferences the float threshold array from this+0x0, clamps a2 upward to the FloatArrayThresholdSearch boundary when a2 is below it, then returns a2 scaled by the penalty scale factor 0.035 as a double.

operations.description: Dereference this+0x0 to obtain the float threshold array pointer v2
Call FloatArrayThresholdSearch(v2) to find the threshold boundary from the float array
When a2 is below or equal to the returned threshold, clamp a2 up to that threshold
Scale the clamped a2 by 0.035, the penalty scale factor constant
Return the scaled value as double

unresolved: Owner object unknown; this points to a member holding a float threshold array pointer.
